title: All American Breakfast Muffins
description: A hearty breakfast muffin recipe with hash browns, sausage, cheese, and eggs, perfect for meal prep and quick mornings.
steps: Add frozen shredded hash browns to a muffin tin.
Add cooked sausage crumbles to each muffin cup.
Add shredded cheddar cheese to each muffin cup.
In a small mixing bowl, crack 10 eggs, add a splash of milk, salt, and pepper, then mix well.
Pour the egg mixture into each muffin cup, filling them up.
Bake in the oven at 350°F for about 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove from oven, and serve. Optional: cut in half to admire the cooked eggs.
